title: A tű, a kutya, a rák, a tojás és a kakas vándorútja
titleEn: The Pin, the Dog, the Crayfish, the Egg and the Cockerel
titleRo: Călătoria acului, câinelui, racului, oului și cocoșului

video.huTitle: Magyar népmesék: A tű, a kutya, a rák, a tojás és a kakas vándorútja
video.enTitle: The Wandering of the Pin, the Dog, the Crayfish, the Egg and the Cock

summary.hu: A tű, a kutya, a rák, a tojás és a kakas útra kelnek.
summary.en: The pin, the dog, the crayfish, the egg and the rooster set off on a journey.
summary.ro: Acul, câinele, racul, oul și cocoșul pornesc la drum.

summary.en: In the evening they sleep in the foxes' den.

summary.hu: A rókák nincsenek otthon: lopni mentek.
summary.en: The foxes aren't home: they've gone stealing.
summary.ro: Vulpile nu sunt acasă: au plecat să fure.

summary.hu: Amikor a rókák hazajönnek, a barátok megleckéztetik őket!
summary.en: When the foxes come home, the friends teach them a lesson!
summary.ro: Când vulpile vin acasă, prietenii le dau o lecție!

questions.qEn: Where do they sleep in the evening?
